posts.name: Curropepe
posts.cooked:
First of all, my apollogies for my bad English, I'll try to be as clear as possible :P

I read somewhere (I can't remember where) that Villain Cards were going to be Oversized with Vengeance, so it's going to be impossible to find regular-sized cards for those. Looking for consistency, I ordered the Oversized Villain Pack, and the promos were included in the order. Today, my order, has arrived, and I'm surprised to see the new promo Villains are regular-sized, so my question is: Will these villains have their own Oversized version? And, if that's the case, will it be possible to find them outside the GtG store? Because the shipping costs to Europe are 45$, and I would love to have all Villain Cards the same size.

Thanks in advance!

posts.cooked: They will - they're planning to print a second over-sized set of villain cards that will include all of the newer versions. I'm assuming they'll be available at local stores, but that's just an assumption; if the current set is available, it will be also.

posts.cooked:
So far we need corrections for The Dreamer, La Capitan and The Matriarch, plus adding in the new ones. Normal Spite could also use a corection for where on the card the start and end of turn stuff is, as it doesn't match the small card, even though there's only 1 card in the game that it matters for, Sub-Zero Atmoshpere.

I also just went through the cards and The Operative's advanced text on the small card says "hero", while the oversized card says "hero target". I'm assuming hero target is the correct one and that the small one just got overlooked.
